description: Angular directive for managing ellipsis behavior in a chip list component, including resize and intersection observation.

classes.name: EllipsisChipListDirective
classes.description: Angular directive that adjusts chip list display with ellipsis and handles resize/intersection events.

methods.name: set chips
methods.description: Setter for chips input; triggers adjustment if value changes.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes styles, event subscriptions, and intersection observer.

methods.name: observeIntersection
methods.description: Sets up IntersectionObserver to trigger chip adjustment on element visibility.

methods.name: adjustChips
methods.description: Adjusts chip display, manages ellipsis, and visibility based on available width.

methods.name: applyMaxChipTextWidth
methods.description: Applies CSS styles to limit text width with ellipsis.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and disconnects intersection observer.
